jobs.title: Global Product Management Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Analyst, Global P roduct Management

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at , and its leaders, will support and guide you. W ith a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a Global Product Management Analyst for Meguiar’s , you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

- Managing the product lifecycle across launch, growth, maturity, renovation, and phase-out, ensuring alignment with retailer reset calendars, pack-price architecture, and promotional strategies to deliver financial and strategic targets.

- Updating SKUs and artwork to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements

- Execut ing the new product roadmap by partnering with R&D, supply chain, finance, marketing communications, and area commercial teams to bring innovations to market on time, on cost, and on quality, while meeting Stage-Gate requirements and retailer acceptance criteria.

- Optimiz ing portfolio performance and leading corrective actions as needed , including pricing, SKU mix, margin management, and trade spend effectiveness, leveraging syndicated data, POS analytics, and shopper insights to guide decisions.

- Translating customer, consumer, and market insights into actionable product decisions, refining packaging, claims, positioning, and promotional support to win at point-of-sale and digital shelf.

- Develop ing product business cases and forecasts using elasticity analysis, price/mix modeling, and demand planning tools to inform investment decisions and prioritize resources across channels and packs.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)

- Six (6 ) years of data and reporting analytics experience in Marketing, New Product Commercialization, Sales, and/or Business in a private, public, government, or military environment

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

- MBA or graduate degree from an accredited university, with focus on marketing, strategy, business development, and/or innovation

- Previous experience working in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) industry

- Previous experience working in the automotive industry

- Knowledge or experience in mass retail, online, and/or other consumer channels

- Knowledge and interest in cars and consumer behaviors and trends in auto appearance

- Demonstrated success leading projects and cross functional teams to create winning solutions

- Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret various data and drive to decisions

- Familiarity with AI-based tools

- Excellent presentation and communication skills

- Knowledge and experience with the theories and practices of one or more disciplines such as: market research, channel marketing, business/market development, branding, new product development, marketing communications or sales.

Work location:

- Work location:

This role follows an on-site working model, requiring the employee to work at least four days a week at the Meguiar’s Headquarters in Irvine, CA

- Travel: May include up to 10% domestic/international

- Relocation: Not authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Job Description:

Global Product Strategy & Management Director, Automotive Electronics Solutions

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a Global Product Strategy & Management Director for Automotive Electronics Solutions you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

- Leads the development and execution of the global portfolio strategy for Automotive Electronics Solutions, driving sustainable growth across Electrical & Electronics (E/E) architectures, software-defined vehicles, connectivity, electrification, thermal management, and emerging automotive technologies.

- Implements portfolio investment, innovation, and commercialization strategies that accelerate new product introductions, expand specification positions with global OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, and maximize long-term portfolio value and profitability.

- Determines strategic priorities through market intelligence, competitive analysis, customer engagement, and technology trend assessment, identifying growth opportunities and positioning the business to capitalize on evolving vehicle architectures and mobility trends.

- Supports the development of customer-centric technology and product roadmaps by aligning OEM requirements, industry standards, emerging technology trends, and commercial objectives to create differentiated solutions and sustainable competitive advantage.

- Leads strategic partnerships and executive-level relationships with global automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and key industry stakeholders to strengthen market presence, influence future specifications, and unlock new growth opportunities.

- Implements cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Application Engineering, R&D, Marketing, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure successful product launches, operational readiness, and achievement of growth and profitability objectives.

- Leads and develops a global team of Global Product Managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking, customer engagement, talent development, innovation, accountability, and business results.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)

- Ten (10) years' combined years of experience in automotive electronics, electrical architecture, vehicle systems, or adjacent automotive technologies in a private, public, government or military environment

- Five (5) years of experience leading global or regional teams and influencing cross-functional organizations.
- Five (5) years of experience developing and executing portfolio growth strategies, commercialization plans, and new product introductions.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) with strong business, strategic, and financial acumen.

- Deep expertise in automotive electronics, including vehicle electrical/electronic (E/E) architectures, software-defined vehicles, connectivity, electrification, and emerging mobility technologies.

- Demonstrated success influencing senior executives, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders in a complex global environment without direct authority.

- Strong customer and market orientation, with the ability to convert customer insights into strategic investments, innovation priorities, and commercial growth initiatives.

- Extensive experience partnering with global automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, with a strong understanding of automotive value chains and product development cycles.

Technical Product Owner - eCommerce

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a Technical Product Owner for eCommerce, you will collaborate with global teams to shape and deliver high-impact digital solutions. This role blends product strategy, technical fluency, and hands-on execution to define capabilities that meet business needs and support scalable, modern eCommerce experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to define requirements, manage the product backlog, and deliver features that provide measurable value to customers and internal stakeholders. You will also drive alignment across business groups and IT teams on process design, architectural direction, and solution delivery for key programs.

Responsibilities:
- Strategic Alignment:  Translate company and customer goals into product direction. Serve as the connection between business leaders, stakeholders, and development teams to ensure alignment with the product vision and overall business strategy.
- Product Vision & Roadmap:  Own the product roadmap and maintain a prioritized backlog aligned with business goals and technical strategy. Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and partner with business leaders to confirm the roadmap supports required business outcomes.
- Prioritization & Execution:  Prioritize work based on business value and urgency, make trade-off decisions, and define clear objectives and success metrics. Use Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to guide prioritization and break work into actionable steps for discovery, design, development, and delivery.
- Voice of the Customer:  Represent customer and stakeholder needs by gaining a deep understanding of workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes. Provide clear direction to IT teams and serve as a trusted partner throughout the product lifecycle.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Manage dependencies across teams and ensure timely, transparent communication. Tailor messaging for different audiences and support a culture of continuous improvement.
- Product Delivery & Validation:  Lead delivery activities and ensure the team understands the product vision. Guide backlog refinement, planning sessions, and validation of completed work to confirm it meets quality and business expectations.
- Change Management & Enablement:  Develop and execute change management and enablement plans to support new system implementations and process improvements.
- Backlog Management & Technical Requirements:  Own, refine, and prioritize the product backlog for the core commerce engineering team. Translate business goals into detailed epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and API requirements. Balance business-driven feature requests with technical modernization, cloud infrastructure upgrades, and technical debt reduction.
- Commerce Platform Domain Expertise:  Collaborate with enterprise and solution architects to shape and validate end-to-end integration patterns between the commerce platform (e.g., SAP Commerce Cloud/Hybris or comparable composable/enterprise commerce platform) and custom microservices and frontend applications. Partner with architects and lead engineers to evaluate the technical feasibility of functional requirements, and leverage platform knowledge to write precise technical acceptance criteria.
- Delivery & Agile Collaboration:  Partner daily with tech leads, software engineers, QA, and Scrum Masters in standard Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Refinement, Daily Standups, Demos). Define Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) tailored to both functional outcomes and technical performance benchmarks. Support validation of technical implementations through end-to-end acceptance testing and API schema verification prior to production releases.
- Stakeholder Alignment & Product Strategy:  Work closely with Business Product Managers, Sales Operations, and Supply Chain teams to balance technical debt remediation with business feature delivery. - Experience with SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) is preferred, or a comparable composable/enterprise commerce platform (e.g., commerce tools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce)
- Understanding of digital commerce platforms, APIs, and enterprise integrations
- Proficiency with backlog management tools (e.g., Jira)
- Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery models, including experience defining DoR/DoD and working in scaled Agile environments
- Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
- Experience with large-scale enterprise integration projects

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

Role Summary
The Technical Program Manager (TPM) serves as 3M's primary technical and manufacturing operations leader at contract manufacturing partners, responsible for driving manufacturing process development, production readiness, operational performance, and technical risk management throughout the product lifecycle.

The TPM acts as the key interface between Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, and contract manufacturing partners to ensure manufacturing processes are scalable, capable, and optimized to meet product performance, quality, cost, capacity, and delivery objectives from New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production.

This role combines technical leadership, manufacturing engineering expertise, and operational excellence to ensure contract manufacturers achieve and sustain world-class manufacturing performance. The TPM is responsible for driving key manufacturing metrics including Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), Yield, Scrap, Downtime, Throughput, Cycle Time, Capacity Utilization, and Process Capability (Cp/Cpk), while leading continuous improvement initiatives that improve quality, productivity, and manufacturing competitiveness.

Key Responsibilities
Manufacturing Process Development & Production Readiness
- Lead manufacturing process development, qualification, and production readiness activities for new product introductions (NPI), product transfers, and major process changes.
- Define process requirements, operating windows, manufacturing controls, tooling requirements, and equipment readiness plans to support successful production launches.
- Drive process characterization activities and establish validated operating parameters that ensure consistent product quality and process stability.
- Partner with contract manufacturers to develop robust, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing processes that meet 3M product specifications and customer requirements.
- Lead engineering builds, pilot runs, process validations, and production ramp activities.
- Drive IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation, line qualifications, and manufacturing readiness reviews.
- Establish process control plans, reaction plans, SPC methodologies, and process monitoring strategies.
- Evaluate manufacturing readiness and proactively identify technical risks that may impact quality, schedule, capacity, or production performance.

Production Performance, Capacity & Operational Excellence
- Own manufacturing performance metrics including Yield, OEE, Scrap, Downtime, Throughput, Cycle Time, Capacity Utilization, and Process Capability (Cp/Cpk).
- Develop KPI dashboards and performance review mechanisms with contract manufacturers to monitor operational health and identify improvement opportunities.
- Analyze manufacturing performance data to identify trends, bottlenecks, variability, and emerging risks.
- Drive yield improvement initiatives through data-driven problem solving, statistical analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
- Lead OEE improvement programs focused on reducing downtime, setup losses, speed losses, and quality losses.
- Drive scrap reduction initiatives through defect elimination, process optimization, and improved material utilization.
- Improve throughput and productivity through cycle time reduction, line balancing, bottleneck elimination, and automation solutions.
- Establish and monitor process capability requirements for critical process parameters and key product characteristics.
- Support production planning and capacity management activities by performing capacity analyses and forecasting future manufacturing requirements.
- Partner with operations teams to improve manufacturing efficiency, labor productivity, and overall factory performance.

Technical Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis
- Lead investigations and resolution of complex manufacturing, process, equipment, and quality-related issues.
- Utilize structured problem-solving methodologies including 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, DMAIC, FMEA, DOE, Six Sigma, and statistical analysis techniques.
- Conduct deep-dive root cause analysis for yield loss, scrap generation, downtime events, process excursions, equipment reliability issues, and manufacturing bottlenecks.
- Apply statistical tools including SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, Minitab, JMP, regression analysis, and design of experiments to improve process performance.
- Develop, implement, and validate corrective and preventative actions that deliver sustainable improvements in manufacturing performance.
- Partner with Product Engineering and Quality Engineering teams to investigate product non-conformances and manufacturing-related defects.
- Ensure technical issues are resolved with permanent corrective actions and measurable business impact.

Technology Transfer, Industrialization & Process Scale-Up
- Lead technical transfer activities between suppliers and contract manufacturing partners.
- Ensure successful deployment of manufacturing processes, tooling, equipment, automation systems, and work instructions.
- Drive process scale-up activities from prototype through pilot production and mass production.
- Verify manufacturing processes achieve target performance levels for Yield, OEE, Throughput, Capacity, Quality, and Process Capability prior to production release.
- Conduct process capability studies and readiness assessments to support manufacturing ramp decisions.
- Perform bottleneck analyses and capacity modeling to ensure manufacturing readiness for volume growth.
- Ensure manufacturing systems are capable of meeting current and future production demand requirements.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership
- Serve as the primary technical and manufacturing operations representative between 3M and contract manufacturing partners.
- Provide technical leadership and direction across Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and external manufacturing teams.
- Lead technical workstreams and coordinate execution across multiple stakeholders and organizations.
- Facilitate regular manufacturing performance reviews focused on quality, yield, OEE, capacity, delivery, and operational improvement initiatives.
- Communicate technical status, manufacturing performance, risks, mitigation plans, and recommendations to leadership and project teams.
- Drive cross-functional decision-making and alignment to resolve manufacturing constraints and meet business objectives.
- Escalate and manage critical manufacturing risks that could impact customer commitments, quality performance, or production schedules.
- Influence investment decisions related to equipment, automation, tooling, and process improvement initiatives.

Manufacturing Innovation & Continuous Improvement
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on Yield, OEE, Throughput, Scrap Reduction, Downtime Reduction, Capacity Expansion, and Cost of Poor Quality reduction.
- Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and Operational Excellence methodologies to improve manufacturing performance.
- Drive automation initiatives and advanced manufacturing technologies that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
- Implement data-driven manufacturing management practices through KPI visualization, SPC systems, and performance dashboards.
- Identify and deploy best practices across multiple manufacturing sites and suppliers.
- Evaluate emerging technologies, equipment, and manufacturing methods that enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and cost competitiveness.
- Support long-term manufacturing strategy and capability development for strategic contract manufacturing partners.
- Champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and technical excellence.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Bilingual fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English.
- 5+ years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Technical Program Management, Product Industrialization, or related technical manufacturing roles.
- Demonstrated experience leading new product introduction (NPI), process development, industrialization, or manufacturing transfer programs.
- Strong understanding of manufacturing process development, qualification methodologies, process validation, and production ramp management.
- Experience working directly with contract manufacturers, suppliers, or external manufacturing partners.
- Strong knowledge of manufacturing performance metrics including OEE, Yield, Throughput, Downtime, Scrap, Cycle Time, Capacity Utilization, and Process Capability.
- Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies including 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA, DOE, SPC, DMAIC, and Six Sigma.
- Experience using data analysis and statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP, Excel, Power BI, or equivalent analytics platforms.
- Strong understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC), process capability analysis (Cp/Cpk), and manufacturing process monitoring.
- Proven ability to lead complex technical programs and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
- Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
- Willingness to travel regularly and maintain an on-site presence at contract manufacturing facilities as required.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree in an engineering or technical discipline.
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing environments such as electronics, medical devices, consumer products, optics, automotive, industrial products, or advanced materials.
- Demonstrated success improving OEE, Yield, Throughput, Capacity Utilization, and Scrap performance in manufacturing operations.
- Experience in injection molding, converting, coating, assembly, automation, or related manufacturing processes.
- Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma Black Belt/Green Belt, TPM (Total Productive Maintenance), or Operational Excellence programs.
- Knowledge of MES systems, manufacturing dashboards, production reporting, and digital factory technologies.
- Experience with automation equipment, robotics, vision systems, and advanced manufacturing technologies.
- Familiarity with quality management systems including ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or similar standards.
- Experience conducting capacity analysis, line balancing, labor optimization, and factory productivity improvement initiatives.
- Experience supporting global manufacturing organizations and working across multiple time zones.

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

As the Technical Program Manager for EBO, you will drive the technical and operational success of new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining programs from development through hyperscale volume production. You will lead and align a cross-functional team of engineers-including Product Engineering, Supplier Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, and DFx-to ensure contract manufacturers are fully prepared to meet production readiness and scale requirements.
You will serve as the primary technical escalation point for issues related to ferrule production processes, driving root cause analysis and resolution to keep programs on schedule and quality targets intact. Your ability to manage complexity, anticipate risk, and coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain functions will directly enable seamless transitions from NPI into mass production-ensuring 3M continues to deliver reliable, high-quality products at scale.

Key Responsibilities
- Technical lead for manufacturing operations at Vendor(s)
- Drive contract manufacturer preparation for pre-production builds
- Serve as the primary technical authority and escalation point for all issues related to ferrule production processes, driving deep root cause analysis and hands-on problem-solving to ensure effective, permanent closure.
- Provide technical leadership and direction to a cross-functional team of engineers (Product Engineering, Supplier Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, DFx, and others) throughout new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining production phases.
- Own the technical readiness assessment of contract manufacturers, ensuring processes, tooling, and quality systems are fully capable of supporting hyperscale volume production.
- Drive technical decision-making on process design, yield improvement, and manufacturability, partnering closely with DFx and process engineering to optimize production outcomes.
- Lead technical deep-dives and root cause investigations for critical production issues, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are technically sound and sustainable at scale.
- Guide engineering teams in resolving complex, cross-disciplinary technical challenges spanning product design, process engineering, and manufacturing execution.
- Evaluate new process technologies, equipment, and methods to improve ferrule production quality, throughput, and cost-efficiency.
- Collaborate with contract manufacturers' technical teams to troubleshoot production issues on-site or remotely, ensuring rapid and effective resolution.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

OTC IT SAP Functional Lead / Product Owner

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As an OTC IT SAP Product Owner / Functional Lead, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. This role will partner with business and IT teams to define priorities, manage the product backlog, and deliver solutions that improve process efficiency, customer experience, and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on SAP Functional Lead who combines strong S/4HANA Order Management expertise with excellent communication and delivery skills. They are comfortable working autonomously, can quickly gather and analyze information, maintain strong documentation standards, and effectively manage work through Jira while leading business-critical fulfillment initiatives.

Key Responsibilities •
- Lead SAP Order Management and Fulfillment functional initiatives.
- Own and prioritize the OTC product backlog.
- Act as the subject matter expert for OTC processes and related integrations.
- Translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
- Gather business requirements and translate them into user stories.
- Partner with stakeholders across customer service, supply chain, and IT.
- Support JIRA & Scrum activities, including sprint planning, testing, and releases.
- Identify opportunities to improve OTC processes such as order management, order fulfilment, POA, ASN, ATP, etc.
- Support change management, adoption, and user communication.
- Provide guidance and support to project teams, business stakeholders, and offshore resources.
- Lead requirement gathering discussions and solution design sessions.
- Prepare Functional Specifications and support technical developments.
- Coordinate testing activities including PIT, UAT, and regression testing.
- Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and continuous improvement activities.
- Manage and prioritize functional requests using Jira.
- Ensure proper documentation of requirements, functional designs, test cases, and support procedures.
- Provide regular status reporting to project leadership and stakeholders.
- Contribute to governance and best-practice standards.
- Experience with agentic ai api resources

Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
- Eight (8) years of SAP functional experience in a private, public, government or military environment

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
- Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
- Experience with EDI/customer collaboration platforms.
- Knowledge of SAP Business Process Monitoring and analytics.
- SAP S/4HANA certification.
- Experience in multinational manufacturing
- Strong experience in SAP SD / Order Management / Fulfillment processes.
- Proven experience with SAP and S/4HANA implementations or transformations.
- Strong understanding of SAP / S/4HANA OTC architecture.
- Hands-on expertise in:
- o ATP / Advanced ATP (aATP)
- o Scheduling Agreements
- o ASN processes
- o POA processes
- o Order Fulfillment and Delivery Management
- o EDI Process
- o Output Management
- o Pricing
- o Customer collaboration and supply chain integration
- Experience with integration points involving:
- o MM
- o EWM / Warehouse processes
- o Transportation and Logistics
- o Procurement and Supplier Collaboration
- Ability to produce clear, structured, and high-quality documentation includin g:
- o Business Requirements
- o Functional Specifications
- o Process Flows
- o Test Scripts
- o Knowledge Transfer Material

Work location: 3M Campus (Maplewood, MN)
Travel: May include up to 25% domestic/international
Relocation: Is not authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being
3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Chat with Max
For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.
